Class KineticsSimulation

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.view3D.kineticsDemo.KineticsSimulation
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.Simulation
public class KineticsSimulation extends Object implements edu.cnu.mdi.sim.Simulation
Simulation wrapper for the kinetic-gas demo.

This class contains no UI code. It is executed on the simulation thread by SimulationEngine. Any UI updates must be requested through the engine (SimulationEngine.requestRefresh(), SimulationEngine.postProgress(ProgressInfo), etc.).
